lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca12Mg6O24 (reduced formula Ca2MgO4) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 166), with 42 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Ca and Mg centers, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while O centers show four geometric neighbors (three Ca and one Mg). Corner-sharing between Ca- and Mg-centered octahedra is observed, along with edge-sharing among Ca-centered octahedra, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
